Since:

- Line 6 only reads v and c (read-only index arrays), not u

**Fix: Split the loop into two independent passes:**
1. **Pass 1:** Update all u values (line 6 for all i) — this is Do-All: each iteration i writes to a distinct u[ju[i]]
2. **Pass 2:** Update all v values using the updated u (line 7 for all i) — also Do-All: each iteration i writes to a distinct v[jv[i]]

This eliminates the loop-carried dependence because all u updates finish before any u reads occur, and within each pass there are no inter-iteration dependencies.
